topics.displayName: Say hello and ask about town

lines.text: Frank wipes down the gas station counter even though it doesn't need it.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Hey, the broken-down-car guy! Anybody looked at your engine yet? Terrible business last night, huh? Robert must be wrecked, that man's a saint.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Known him for... uh, fifteen years, maybe more. Never once seen him give anyone a hard time. Not once.

topics.displayName: Ask if he saw anything odd last night

lines.speaker: Gabe
lines.text: Did you see anything odd last night, before what happened at the motel?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Mmm... now that you mention it, yeah. Saw Mark run into a girl near the highway. Arguing or something, I don't know, I was far off.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Didn't think much of it, Mark's always talking to himself or to someone who isn't there. But now that you ask.

topics.displayName: Chat with him about Robert again

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Robert's always hauling stuff for that generator in the basement. Boxes, bags. I tell him, hey, hire somebody, and he just laughs.
He says it in passing, no weight to it. To him it's just another story about a hardworking friend.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Good guy. One of the few around here who really handles everything himself.
